basics.name: Vincenzo Messina
basics.label: Space Engineer · Research Associate at the Technical University of Munich
basics.summary: Research Associate and doctoral candidate at the Chair of Spacecraft Systems, Technical University of Munich. My research develops algorithms and methodologies for optimizing the operations and coordination of decentralized federations of autonomous satellites, enabling them to pursue collective objectives while operating independently under the limited computational capabilities and resources available on board.

highlights: Conducting research to develop novel algorithms and methodologies for optimizing the operations and coordination of a decentralized federation of autonomous satellites, enabling them to achieve collective objectives while maintaining independent operation, with consideration of the limited computational capabilities and resources available on board.
Teaching theoretical and practical courses across space engineering and systems engineering, and supervising master's and bachelor's theses.
Identifying research funding calls, writing proposals, publishing papers, presenting at conferences, and writing a PhD thesis dissertation.

work.summary: Lecturer for the Space Mission Design course delivered at TUM Asia.

highlights: Design, manufacturing and testing of a 50N hybrid thruster using High-Test Peroxide as oxidizer and paraffin or high-density polyethylene as fuel.
